# Which vendors actually need a 1099-NEC this year?

> Track which contractors need a 1099-NEC under the 2026 $2,000 reporting threshold (up from $600), check the corporation exemption, and see missing W-9s before the January 31 deadline. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
